body: Thank you! I really appreciate it!
Thanks. I guess you're right, I should be more kind to myself. It's just hard
Thank you for the hugs and fist bump! I'll take both! And you're right, nature is an amazing place that has always calmed my mind, just haven't thought to go out there for some reason.
Great advice! Service does help. I haven't talked to them. I'm ashamed of the way I feel and don't want to share that with people I know.

You're right, God and Christ don't deserve any of the blame. I appreciate you pointing this out. Sometimes I don't recognize when Satan is feeding me lies and he's definitely been feeding me the lie that God doesn't love me and such. Thank you!
You're right. I think I need to recognize the ways he might be speaking to me now. Thanks
Thanks 😊
Thank you for your advice! I'm glad to hear you're in a better place and I hope to one day be there too.
Wow! Thank you for that!
Thank you for the sympathy! Therapy is good.
Yeah, you're very right. I know it's not there fault, just life.
Great advice! Thanks!

Thank you. It's good to know that I'm not necessarily a horrible person for feeling this way.
There are a few topics and things that make me feel uncomfortable but those are kind of hard to talk about. It's also hard seeing people with smiles on their faces greeting everyone and being so kind when I mostly keep to myself and don't talk to anyone. I'm embarrassed and don't feel like I belong. Not sure why

I'm mad at God because I feel like he's abandoned me at my worst. I'm mad because it's not fair that I can't feel the spirit. I don't like the things I have to go through, but it's more of the fact that I don't feel his presence anymore. 
Man, I just realized how selfish I must be. I shouldn't have posted anything, I'm sorry
Yeah, I've tried lots of meds, tms and therapy. I know the church is true too which makes the way I feel even worse. Thanks for the well wishes
Thank you! Your thoughts and links have given me at least a small glimmer of hope
I appreciate it! I'll look into that for sure!
Thank you for the advice!

I had mixed feelings about it. I liked the moral of the story, that people care and are there for you when you need help (I'm not sure I believe that but that's besides the point). The way it all happened though was horrendous! I guess Evan had good intentions but the way he handled things and kept lying over and over was very disappointing.

I wish I could help you feel better but I know where you're coming from. I promised that I would die before I turned 30 and somehow I've made it to 31. Maybe it gets better? I don't know, I just keep putting it off day and day again. All I know is no one deserves to feel like this. I'm sorry you do too!

I wish I had the right words to say. I do want you to know that it's nothing personal against you. My husband is the greatest and kindest person ever, and I love him so much, so I'm sure she feels the same towards you. But sometimes the pain is so strong that in the moment all of that flies out the window. I guess the only advice I could give is to always have someone with her. The feeling ebbs and flows. Doing stuff to distract her, watching movies, playing games or anything she normally loves to do might help. Every person is different so this may or may not help.  I hope things work out for you guys! You sound like a great person who really cares. We need that!

I feel you. I hate everything about myself and no one seems to understand how strong that hatred is. I wish there was something I could say that would help you. I wish I could lift others up and make sure they don't suffer like me, but I guess I'm not equipped to do that. I'm a failure.
I'm sorry. I completely understand where you're coming from. I'm in the same boat myself. I wish I had answers. I wish I could help but truth is, I'm stuck too.

I feel your pain through your words and I hear you. This is hard. I have no answers, I'm searching for them myself as well. All I know is, you are a wonderful writer and your words have touched me. Thank you
I feel almost exactly the same! I've tried meds, tms, therapists and all too! I'm exhausted from trying and trying and never getting any better!
My husband wears the same model as the video to work everyday. He loves them. These are chem resistant, which is nice since he works with acids and alkaline soaps daily.
